One MUST-FIX survives: basedOn.d350.role lodges leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING on leftover-join.v28 of G21 in live present tense, contradicting the subject's own basedOn.d356.role and fifteen sibling sentences that place the G21 leftover standing on leftover-join.v35 of G21 (D-355), and contradicting live COORD, which records two recordable successors of v28 at D-353 and D-355.
